_about: HALO radiation alert thresholds. 'nasa_limits' are NASA's published numbers copied from the source. Every value under 'halo_alert_rules' is DERIVED by our team from those limits (marked basis). Units match Kavya's ISS file radiation_5min.csv: dose_rate_ugy_h (absorbed dose rate, microgray per hour, DOSTEL-1 in ISS Columbus) and observed_dose_accumulated_day_ugy.

alara.text: All crewmember radiation exposures shall be minimized using the ALARA principle.

spe_effective_dose_per_event.note: design reference SPE = sum of the October 1989 events

nasa_limits.also_in: OCHMO-TB-020 Rev E (2022-12-27) radiation protection technical brief: https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/radiation-protection-technical-brief-ochmo.pdf

iss_baseline.source: Berger et al. 2017, J. Space Weather Space Clim. 7, A8 (DOSIS / DOSIS 3D, DOSTEL in Columbus, 2009-2016). DLR/ESA measurement, not a NASA document.

derived_conversion.basis: 647 / 286 from the same paper; use to turn absorbed dose (uGy) into approximate dose equivalent (uSv) and, as an approximation, mGy-Eq for BFO. Approximation only.

halo_alert_rules.basis: watch = more than 2x the measured ISS daily total (~286 uGy/day), ALARA [V1 4029]. act = 3600 uGy x 2.3 = ~8.3 mGy-Eq per day; at that pace the 30-day BFO limit of 250 mGy-Eq (Table 4.8-1) is reached in 30 days.

halo_alert_rules.metric: dose_rate_ugy_h (only when in_saa_box is False; SAA passes are expected spikes and are logged, not alerted)
halo_alert_rules.basis: 25 uGy/h = 2x the ISS daily mean rate (286/24 = ~12 uGy/h; Kavya's own peak_threshold_ugy_h is 11.6). 150 uGy/h = 3600 uGy/day, the act pace above. A sustained rise outside the SAA suggests a solar particle event.
50% and 80% of NASA's 30-day BFO limit, 250 mGy-Eq (Table 4.8-1).

halo_alert_rules.metric: career_dose_msv (prior career + this mission, dose equivalent as effective-dose proxy)
halo_alert_rules.basis: 50% and 80% of NASA career limit 600 mSv [V1 4030]. For scale: 647 uSv/day x 180 days = ~116 mSv for a 6-month ISS mission (~19% of the limit).

halo_alert_rules.metric: spe_event_dose_msv (dose equivalent accumulated since an SPE alert began)
halo_alert_rules.basis: 20% and 50% of NASA's per-event SPE limit, 250 mSv [V1 4031]; act = move crew to the shielded area.
